name: Choise.com Card
summary: Choise.com Card (formerly Crypterium) offers crypto spending in 170+ countries with the CHO token ecosystem. Virtual cards ready in 20 minutes, €2.99/month fee waived with €299+ monthly load.

faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
